description: Source code for PNG bitmap glyph support in FreeType, including functions for premultiplied alpha processing, PNG image reading, and conversion routines.

methods.name: multiply_alpha
methods.description: Multiplies alpha and color components with proper rounding.

methods.name: premultiply_data
methods.description: Premultiplies RGBA data bytes to native endian format.

methods.name: convert_bytes_to_data
methods.description: Converts RGBx bytes to BGRA format.

methods.name: error_callback
methods.description: Handles PNG errors to avoid stderr output.

methods.name: read_data_from_FT_Stream
methods.description: Reads PNG data from FreeType stream.

methods.name: Load_SBit_Png
methods.description: Loads PNG bitmap data into a FreeType glyph slot, handling image decoding and conversion.
